sourceReceipts.finding: Canada Post defines ANA NAN as a three-character FSA plus three-character LDU. A full code can identify an urban block face, single building, large-volume receiver or rural community; it is not universally an area.
Postal Code Address Data is described as the complete list of Canadian postal codes and address ranges, distributed by secure FTP with monthly updates under a licensed-data product workflow.
The current review-date Postal Code Address Data release is 260807ad.zip, posted 2026-08-07; the next scheduled file is 260911ad.zip. No licensed file was acquired.

The specification defines address, range, lock-box, route, general-delivery, building and large-volume-receiver records plus change and cross-reference files. It publishes no Polygon/MultiPolygon, CRS or topology schema.

The form asks about internal, third-party, geospatial and derivative use, sublicensing, hosting, bulk-download and scraping controls. Submission leads to pricing details and the applicable licence agreement. It was not submitted.

AddressComplete requires a key and exposes Find/Retrieve address lookup operations. It is neither a fixed complete public assignment release nor postal-area geometry. No credential or response row was used.

The terms limit Canada Post Data to licensed internal-business purposes, retain confidentiality and ownership controls and require destruction in stated circumstances. Public unrestricted assignment or geometry serving was not authorized.
The guide defines 1,643 CFSAs derived from respondent-reported 2021 postal codes and dissemination areas and warns they may differ from Canada Post-assigned FSA geography.

The methodology assigns a dominant reported FSA to each dissemination area and dissolves those areas to form census polygons. It is three-character census reference geography, not current six-character LDU geometry.

The Statistics Canada Open Licence permits eligible Statistics Canada information use subject to attribution and conditions. It does not convert Canada Post licensed assignment intellectual property into open data or make 2021 CFSA a current full-code postal area.

applicationAssessment.reason: No approved immutable current six-character CA assignment and real postal Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact exists. CFSA is open three-character 2021 census reference geometry and cannot stand in for the submitted full code. Browser execution would validate only shared code or a synthetic fixture.

blockers: The current complete Canada Post assignment file is a monthly licensed product. Acquisition requires provider contact, a completed use request, pricing and an applicable licence agreement; it was not acquired or authorized for AGID redistribution/public serving.
The licensed address-data schema contains addresses, ranges and typed non-area objects but publishes no six-character Polygon/MultiPolygon, CRS or topology release.
A full code can identify a block face, building, large-volume receiver, lock box, route, general-delivery object or rural community. These objects cannot be expanded to invented surfaces.
The open 2021 CFSA layer is only the first three characters, respondent-derived and census-vintage; it is not necessarily Canada Post-assigned FSA geography and has no LDU/full-code geometry.
PCCF coordinates, CFSA/FSA, NAR points, ODB footprints, administrative areas, roads, parcels, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, models and AGID cells are prohibited full-code postal-area proxies.
